Motion brief: Squat violet hermit-crab locksmith with a huge purple spiral shell, brass padlock details, pale eyes, oversized brass key claw, small purple claw, two sturdy boot legs. Side-view crisp 16-bit pixel art, always facing right. Move: hurt reaction — a brief flinch, recoil, then recovery; no attacker visible. Side-view fighting game sprite row.
